title: Nasty Liq Berry Bull 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Nasty Juice
description: Nasty Liq's Berry Bull is a bold concoction that mimics the flavour profile of a fresh and bubbly energy drink, complemented by a generous helping of mixed berries. The e-liquid unfurls with the robust taste reminiscent of the popular beverage, sans the caffeine. It's a flavour that's both familiar and exciting, primed to deliver a zesty and enlivening vaping experience. As the fruity base note settles, a selection of berries enters the fray, adding depth and dimension to each puff. Strawberries infuse a dose of summery sweetness, while raspberries interject with their signature tartness. Blueberries round out the mix with their rich, fruit-forward profile, crafting a well-rounded taste that's both varied and enthralling. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the Nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more delicious Nasty Liq flavours to try. Nasty Juice have fine-tuned their vape juices for optimised performance with the vast majority of MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices. They feature exceptional flavours and flavour blends across fruits, sweets, desserts and tobacco and many are also available in Nasty Juice’s super-convenient Nasty Bar disposable vape bars.
